# Published marital-status tract cells

These fixtures contain aggregate Statistics Canada custom-tabulation cells for
Montréal CTs 4620053.00, 4620054.00 and 4620056.00 in each vintage. The data
were distributed under the [Statistics Canada Open Licence](https://www.statcan.gc.ca/en/reference/licence).

- [2016, Borealis CDKEOF](https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/CDKEOF), file 428828.
- [2021, Borealis UHEPKL](https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/UHEPKL), file 428826.

The fixtures retain the required rows from the checksum-verified output of
[scripts/extract_marital_status_tracts.py](../../../scripts/extract_marital_status_tracts.py).
The broad controls and linked candidate households constructed by the test
are fictional.
